content.short: EZO is a Canadian all-in-one financial app with payments, financial services, and investments.
content.description: EZO is a Canadian all-in-one financial app that brings together payments, financial services, and investments in a single platform. Its mission is to make financial accessibility a universal right, while its vision is to enable financial services for everyone, regardless of location or economic status. EZO provides individuals and businesses with the tools to manage their finances efficiently and securely, helping them achieve their financial goals with greater ease and confidence.
